_comment: Copy to pipeline/character/<video>/planning-approval.json, beside a v2 plan. Written by video-lock (or by hand) when the user approves this exact revision. content_sha256 is the digest of the whole plan without 'approved': scripts/character/bridge.py digest plan.json. Production (shots.py check) refuses a v2 plan whose content does not match it. It also refuses an approval with "dry_run": true (video-lock --dry-run): a rehearsal of the lock is never the user's approval. Any change to words, actions, timing, cast, narrator, sources, series, layout, placement or overlays is a new revision and a new approval.
words: <the user's words, the same as plan.approved.words>
